RUST RUNTIME LOOP — effects every file · 5000ms tick
then writes updates to these paths:
BROWSER POOL — 8 HTMX/SVG instances · inference rotation
Each browser = 1 layer. Targets specific passes. Ignores others. Coherence enforced by runtime.
• pushes diff events to runtime loop
• validates pair crystal on every tick
• routes inference to browser-N by pass
• pushes visual updates to all browsers
ORCHESTRATION FLOW — how browsers accent each other
runtime loop (5000ms) reads browser-3 state → feeds browser-2 scheduler → cycle repeats
1. A browser NEVER reads another worker's layer directly
2. All inter-browser data flows through browser-5 (composite)
3. browser-2 (sched) is the ONLY dispatcher — no worker self-routes
4. If browser-5 detects missing input, it HOLDs and signals browser-3
5. browser-3 writes the HOLD to JSONL → runtime loop audits
Result: chain always coherent. No orphan states.
• Worker crash: sched reroutes to alt model (fallback CSV)
• Sched crash: browser-3 takes over with last-known plan
• Mirror drift: runtime loop triggers bijection check (T-3 daemon)
• Genesis hash mismatch: full rebuild from Run #2 crystal
• Network partition: browser queues events, reconciles on reconnect
All failures are logged in JSONL with error + recovery path.
↔ = cross-project sync · ★ = this file · ⚡ = DB write · ⧉ = browser state
